session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.title: Plumbing Track implementation ledger — 2026-09-09
session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.content: Comprehensive final record for the live pt-site-updates implementation session. Scope covered the docs-led homepage rebuild; dedicated Book an Assessment flow; shared header/footer and responsive menu across non-assessment pages; Our Work proof library; gold/navy palette corrections; section sizing; orphan-aware typography; testimonial contrast and author emphasis; card images, shadows, and animation; CTA button geometry, spacing, chevrons, and colors; scroll threshold behavior; Resources menu reduction to FAQ and Client Portal; tablet/mobile no-overflow corrections; and live browser verification. Grapher now includes implementation records, failure/hiccup records, and linked tests for assessment fit, pinned hero behavior, responsive navigation, and global card reveals.
